notes: Plans and promises. Plans you make out loud in the story ("tomorrow at six, the arcade") are now tracked just like phone invites: the other person puts it in their schedule and shows up, and if you don't, they notice and may text you about it. Promises are remembered too ("I'll pay you back by Friday"); overdue or broken ones get brought up. 🧰 Tools → 🤝 Plans shows what's coming up, how past plans went, and your promises, which you can mark as kept or broken.
